status: Kernel-certified shared fan charge and an actual third-centre continuation.

general_law.domain: Finite simple graph with a triangular vertexwise cyclic dart rotation; exact pinned 84-rule charge semantics.
general_law.fan: A six-valent sender has two consecutive degree-five neighbours on each side of its edge to a receiver of degree at least seven.
general_law.degree_seven_guard: All neighbours of the receiver have degree five or six.
general_law.reverse_charge: Zero on every outgoing edge under the low-neighbour guard; all remaining incoming terms are nonnegative.
general_law.flat_consequence: If every neighbour has degree at least five, a flat degree-seven receiver of the fan has an adjacent vertex of degree at least seven.

actual_consumer.root: Both rules are matched on the same actual directed edge.
actual_consumer.guards: Sender six, next neighbour five, first free neighbour a seven and flat, second free neighbour b five.
actual_consumer.conclusion: A third high-degree centre adjacent to a, distinct from a and the original receiver, within radius three of the original receiver.
actual_consumer.non_return_reason: An edge back to the original receiver would be a nonfacial triangle, excluded by the actual minimal-map facial triangle theorem.
actual_consumer.radius_scope: The radius-three conclusion locates the third centre. It does not assert that every source-rule observation is within that radius.

finite_example.kernel_conclusion: The complete cyclic triangular geometry satisfies the fan and low-neighbour guards; the general theorem gives final charge at least two.

remaining: Degree-eight continuations require more than the twelve-unit bound: their initial deficit is twenty.
The second-free degree-six and other free-degree profiles remain open.
The new centre must be classified with its actual shared signed transfers.
Initial fan supply, longer-cycle control, termination and universal family coverage remain open.
